Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 47

“Your right is to action alone, never to its fruits. Do not let the fruits of action be your motive, nor be attached to inaction.”

The most quoted verse in the Gita, and the closing line is what saves it from becoming an excuse. Detachment from results is not permission to stop — that door is shut in the same breath.
